issue.title: Shrink bob-cli artifact-link-outbox.jsonl so drain does not reread 8k retained rows
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Compact or incrementally read `gh_bobs-org__bob-cli`'s
`artifact-link-outbox.jsonl` so each drain does not re-parse thousands of
retained per-agent observation rows.

The 2026-11-27 10:33 apollo digest (plan
`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md`) measured this file at 8,341
retained rows from 1,543 agents (5.4 MB). Every `drain_artifact_link_outbox`
pass spends about 9s just reading it, before eligibility, catalog, or publish
work. Closed bug sase-1it drained the trusted derived-edge backlog; the
remaining lines are per-agent observation entries, a different cost.

## Why this is out of scope

`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md` only bounds the
`artifact_link_backfill` and `agent_publication` chops so an overloaded tick
defers instead of taking SIGKILL. Shrinking or incrementally reading the
outbox is the base-cost work that plan explicitly left as follow-up.
